bullets.title: AVGO: Earnings beat but AI guide disappointment drives -15% selloff; bulls see FY28 ramp
bullets.body: Broadcom's 2Q revenue of $22.19B beat consensus by 0.3% and 3Q guide of $29.4B beat by 4.1%, but FY26 AI revenue guide of $56B was in-line and FY27 '$100B+' was viewed as disappointing given elevated expectations (Street was ~$17B for 3Q AI alone). Stock fell 15% intraday. Wolfe calls the pullback a buying opportunity, noting management conservatism masks a much larger FY28 ramp — Anthropic (3GW in FY27 + follow-on FY28), OpenAI (1.3GW in 2H27), Meta, Apollo/Blackstone 20GW commitment — with XPU shipments to top-5 LLM deployers projected to exceed GPU shipments by 2028. JPM raised PT to $580 (from $500); Macquarie downgraded to Neutral with $437 PT.

bullets.title: CRWD: Smallest-ever ARR beat and soft NNARR disappoints; FY27 pipeline strong
bullets.body: CrowdStrike F1Q27 ARR grew 24.2% to $5.509B, beating guidance by only $6M — the smallest beat ever — and NNARR of $256M came in well below the $275-280M consensus, sending shares down 10-11%. FY27 ARR guidance was raised by $52.5M and management cited record 2Q pipeline driven by AI/Mythos urgency post-RSA. Citi's Meta Marshall raised PT to $780 (from $525); JPM reiterated OW with $800 PT.

bullets.title: CIEN: Strong Q2 beat, raised FY26 guide, but OpEx surge limits EPS flow-through; stock -9%
bullets.body: Ciena Q2 revenue of $1.57B beat FactSet's $1.50B estimate, EPS of $1.64 beat $1.46 est, and FY26 revenue guidance was raised to $6.2-6.4B from $5.9-6.3B. However, a surprise +6.5% F3Q26 OpEx jump to ~$410M (vs. consensus $387M) limited earnings upside, and the stock fell ~9% in pre-market. Hyper-rail deployments begin 2027 with contracts worth hundreds of millions; TAM seen doubling to ~$50B by FY29. JPM OW with $635 PT maintained.

bullets.title: Semis/Networking complex under pressure: AVGO-driven rotation into software, pharma, financials
bullets.body: Market color from the desk: semiconductors down 3.5% with AVGO, MU, AMD causing ~70bps drag on cap-weighted S&P while equal-weight S&P is up 70bps. A meaningful momentum unwind is underway — 12-month losers up 2.5%, winners down 1.5%. Rotation is described as money moving into catalysts (not risk-off), with pharma and financials (worst YTD) up 2%+. Pre-market SOXX down 4%; MU -5.7%, AMD -4.0%, WDC -3.9%, SMCI -7.2%.

bullets.title: MS QDS: $300B levered ETF short gamma creates tail risk in Tech/Semis; recommends hedging
bullets.body: Levered equity ETF AUM is up 50% YTD to $300B controlling $750B in equities. Semis have record $4.75B global short gamma (1% move), 80% from index products. HF net exposure to Japan, Korea, Taiwan at 15-year-plus highs; Memory >10% of HF books. MS QDS recommends buying puts on Long Momentum (MSXXALLM, 50%+ Semis/Hardware) or KOSPI2 Aug26 80%/60% put spreads at 3.55% as tail hedge. NVDA, MU, TSLA, MSFT, SNDK are most-bought by retail YTD.

bullets.title: CIEN/LITE/NOK/COHR: Networking names flagged as read-across on AVGO/CIEN results
bullets.body: Multiple sources flagged NOK, LITE, COHR, and CIEN as names to watch following AVGO's disappointing AI guide and CIEN's mixed print. Key networking names were down 6-9.5% in pre-market. CLS holds 55% ODM Networking revenue share and has 3-year customer order visibility, but faces 9% FCF growth in 2026 despite 70% earnings growth due to $1B+ capex ramp.

bullets.title: PLTR: Up 2.1% pre-market on multi-tiered Google Cloud partnership
bullets.body: Palantir rose 2.1% in pre-market trading on news of a multi-tiered Google Cloud partnership, bucking the broader tech selloff. No specific financial terms were disclosed in the pre-market summary.

bullets.title: NET: Cloudflare acquires VoidZero (Vite tooling ecosystem); terms undisclosed
bullets.body: Cloudflare acquired VoidZero, the open-source company behind the Vite JavaScript tooling ecosystem. Terms were not disclosed. The acquisition extends Cloudflare's developer platform capabilities.

bullets.title: ROKU: Analyst raises PT to $170 (Street-high) with $200 bull case on subscription value
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley TMT desk notes a ROKU analyst raising the price target to a Street-high $170 with a $200 bull case; approximately 75% of stock value is attributed to the subscriptions segment. No additional near-term catalyst was flagged.

bullets.title: AAPL: New Siri to use Google Cloud infrastructure with NVDA Blackwell B200 chips
bullets.body: MS TMT notes that Apple's upgraded Siri will leverage Google Cloud infrastructure running NVIDIA Blackwell B200 chips for heavy compute workloads. This is incrementally positive for both NVDA (chip demand) and GOOGL (cloud revenue), while confirming Apple's reliance on third-party AI infrastructure.

bullets.title: META: Hatch AI agent potentially priced at $200/mo; new model release delayed again
bullets.body: Citi TMT notes Meta is considering a $200/month charge for its Hatch consumer AI agent, with Muse Spark API rollout targeted for June. Separately, WSJ reports Meta again delayed a new AI model release despite telling partners a June launch was planned.

bullets.title: T/VZ: SpaceX satellite broadband negative for traditional carriers; SCOTUS upholds FCC fines
bullets.body: Oppenheimer analyst sees SpaceX disrupting the $1.6T comms industry and is bearish on T and VZ. Separately, SCOTUS ruled 8-1 that the FCC's enforcement structure is constitutional, reinstating AT&T's original $57M fine from 2020 for location data violations; the Fifth Circuit ruling vacating the fine was reversed.

bullets.title: ORCL: PT raised to $330; F4Q preview expects NNRPO near $600B, FY27 capex ~$80B+
bullets.body: Citi raises Oracle PT to $330 (from $320) ahead of F4Q earnings; expects NNRPO approaching $600B with FY27 EPS guidance ~60% driven by AI OCI ramp. Capex expected to ramp to $80B+ in FY27. Oracle earnings are scheduled for June 10, coinciding with the US CPI release.

bullets.title: WULF: Bernstein initiates Outperform at $36 PT (38% upside); MS raising SEI PT to $90
bullets.body: Bernstein initiates TeraWulf (WULF) at Outperform with a $36 PT implying 38% upside; also initiates Cipher Mining (CIFR) at Outperform with $32 PT. Morgan Stanley raises Solaris Energy (SEI) PT to $90 from $81 with high conviction after SEI secured a third long-term data center contract (600+ MW) and expanded its second deal to 630 MW — each incremental 1 GW is worth ~$9/share per the analyst.

bullets.title: PINS: Expands AWS commitment to $4B through 2031, largest infrastructure deal in company history
bullets.body: Pinterest announced a major expansion of its AWS partnership, committing $4B for cloud services through 2031 — the largest infrastructure commitment in the company's history. The deal is expected to accelerate Pinterest's AI roadmap and improve visual search and shopping experiences.

bullets.title: SNAP: Acquires Illumix to bolster AR capabilities; terms undisclosed
bullets.body: Snap acquired Illumix, an augmented reality technology company, to expand its AR platform. Purchase terms were not disclosed. Snap will adopt Illumix's technology and platform.

bullets.title: SHOP: Up 2-2.8% in pre-market/Canada trading; part of software outperformance rotation
bullets.body: Shopify was among the outperformers in the session, up 2.8% on the TSX and ~2.0% in US pre-market trading, benefiting from the rotation out of semis into software names as AVGO's earnings disappointed.

bullets.title: EXPE/BKNG: EXPE's ChatGPT ad share surges to 70%; LLM search a net positive for OTAs
bullets.body: DA Davidson analysis shows Expedia's share of ChatGPT travel ads surged from 12.5% to 70% in May, while Booking Holdings improved from 12.5% to 20%. Hotel-direct sites maintain 38-45% LLM visibility but a fraction of traditional search share, making OTAs net beneficiaries of LLM-driven travel search.

bullets.title: NFLX: Bernstein maintains Outperform at $110 PT; advertising and content moderation as upside
bullets.body: Bernstein maintains Outperform on Netflix with a $110 price target. Near-term headwinds include the rise of short-form/vertical content and stepped-up content spending. Advertising remains a high-margin contributor and, along with content spend moderation, is identified as a key potential upside driver.

bullets.title: INTC: Lip-Bu era reveals data-sharing failures with SME vendors hindered yield improvements
bullets.body: A post flags that Intel's new leadership under Lip-Bu Tan revealed the prior management did not share sufficient data with semiconductor equipment vendors to optimize manufacturing yields — a significant operational failure now being corrected. Intel's Nova Lake next-gen processors with LGA 1954 socket were also spotted online for the first time.
